jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for experts to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists/activists with regional expertise, not a recent graduate, and reads as a voluntary/advisory position with no vacancy for the candidate. The human-rights and securitisation subject is a strong interest match, but the level and nature of the position are a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: IATF Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Ineligible: this is a "Lead" role requiring a mandatory Certified IATF 16949 Lead Auditor qualification and proven substantial experience conducting third-party audits, none of which the candidate holds. The automotive quality-assurance field is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: IMS Auditor
jobs.reason: Requires a registered IRCA (or equivalent) Lead Auditor qualification, substantial third-party ISO auditing experience, and at least two years managing environmental/safety compliance — essentials the candidate does not meet. It is also an environmental/safety compliance auditing role wholly outside the candidate's research and policy profile and interest zones.
